lead.headline: NYSE Chooses Avalanche for 24/7 Tokenized Stock Settlement
lead.tldr: Traditional market infrastructure is now selecting specific Layer-1s for production-grade tokenization, repricing the sector from speculative promise to competitive procurement.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week institutional infrastructure made concrete chain selections while security failures demonstrated that foresight without implementation is just another form of exposure.

top_signals.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, disrupts North Korean deepfake scheme
top_signals.summary: The US Department of Justice has received court approval to seize over $1.2 billion in assets stolen from Binance. Additionally, the DOJ disrupted a North Korean operation that utilized deepfake video calls for fraudulent schemes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The DOJ's dual action on asset recovery and deepfake disruption signals that state-level crypto enforcement is now targeting both on-chain traceability and social engineering vectors, raising the compliance cost curve for exchanges.

top_signals.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
top_signals.summary: A massive $6.3 billion hack of Binance was carried out using fake job interview tactics, a specific threat that the company's own Chief Security Officer had warned about months prior. The incident highlights a critical failure in implementing security warnings despite internal foresight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $6.3 billion breach executed through a tactic the CSO explicitly warned about is an underwriting signal that security budgets and security posture are decoupled variables in exchange valuation.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Nvidia and Unity join Emulate’s $700m fundraise
top_signals.summary: Emulate has raised $700 million in a massive funding round. The round notably includes participation from Unity and NVentures, the investment arm of Nvidia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nvidia and Unity backing Emulate's $700 million round suggests spatial computing and AI simulation are converging on a capital-intensive hardware-software stack that may absorb Web3 infrastructure investment appetite.

top_signals.title: NYSE to settle tokenized stocks on Avalanche in planned 24/7 market
top_signals.summary: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) plans to implement a 24/7 market for tokenized stocks, utilizing the Avalanche blockchain for trade recording and settlement. The venue intends to support equities issued across multiple blockchains to modernize equity trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: NYSE selecting Avalanche over Ethereum or private ledgers for tokenized equities resets the enterprise chain-selection narrative from 'most decentralized' to 'fastest finality with institutional SLA', which is a repricing event for competing L1s.

top_signals.title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks complete foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems
top_signals.summary: Central banks from the UK, Singapore, and Thailand have successfully completed a trial for foreign exchange settlements linking traditional and tokenized systems. The project aims to improve the efficiency of cross-border payments, with the Bank of England planning a live interface by 2028.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The 2028 live interface target from the Bank of England gives tokenized FX settlement a four-year horizon that institutional allocators can now underwrite against, compressing the traditional five-to-seven year infrastructure deployment cycle.

top_signals.title: Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks
top_signals.summary: President Trump has nominated Steven Levine to succeed Hester Peirce at the SEC. The move is part of a broader set of nominations for the SEC and CFTC intended to precede a Senate power shift.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Steven Levine's nomination to replace Hester Peirce maintains the SEC's crypto policy continuity while the broader commission reshuffle creates a narrow window for rulemaking before potential Senate procedural friction.

deals.summary: Emulate has raised $700 million in a massive funding round. The round notably includes participation from Unity and NVentures, the investment arm of Nvidia.
Alta has raised $47.5 million in a Series A funding round led by Index Ventures. The company is developing a specialized blockchain tailored for use by financial institutions.

Griffin, a UK banking partner for Uber, has raised $20 million to expand its offerings into stablecoin infrastructure and card issuance. The funding round brings the company's valuation to $100 million.
Cambridge-based Hiverge has raised $19.4 million as part of a wider Series A funding round. The company is backed by Plural and has ties to Nvidia.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin falls to 12-week low as Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia rattles markets
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin has dropped to a 12-week low following the sudden resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and MSCI's plan to remove a major bitcoin treasury firm from its indexes. The combined impact of AI sector instability and index adjustments has rattled the digital asset market.

on_the_radar.title: Visa adds Western Union's USDPT stablecoin to its settlement network in Anchorage tie-up
on_the_radar.summary: Visa has integrated Western Union's USDPT stablecoin into its settlement network. This allows Visa and its eligible partners to settle VisaNet obligations using the digital asset issued by Anchorage Digital Bank.

on_the_radar.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized securities to Solana in second half of 2027
on_the_radar.summary: The DTCC plans to integrate tokenized securities onto the Solana blockchain by the second half of 2027. This move follows the recent launch of its tokenization services on the Canton Network and a private Besu network.

on_the_radar.title: Securitize and Ethena's $100 million BlackRock BUIDL liquidity facility goes live
on_the_radar.summary: Securitize and Ethena have launched a $100 million liquidity facility utilizing BlackRock's BUIDL tokenized fund. This follows an integration enabling 24/7 atomic swaps between the tokenized fund and Ethena's stablecoin.

on_the_radar.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
on_the_radar.summary: Deutsche Bank has officially launched a crypto custody service tailored for corporate and institutional clients. The service provides support for major assets including Bitcoin, Ether, and several stablecoins.

on_the_radar.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
on_the_radar.summary: Global banks have committed $270 million to Project Faro to develop a bank-issued dollar stablecoin slated for a 2027 launch. While the project has significant backing, some participating members are simultaneously supporting competing stablecoin initiatives.

on_the_radar.title: Hyperliquid leapfrogs Bybit, Kraken and OKX in open interest as Q3 positions grow 80%
on_the_radar.summary: Hyperliquid has seen a massive surge in open interest during Q3, surpassing major centralized exchanges like Bybit, Kraken, and OKX. The protocol reported a 22% increase in revenue to $191 million, driven by record daily trader numbers and stock-linked trading volumes.

on_the_radar.title: Tether-backed Twenty One Capital reports $1.09 billion Q3 net income on bitcoin gains
on_the_radar.summary: Twenty One Capital, a firm backed by Tether, reported a substantial Q3 net income of $1.09 billion driven primarily by gains in bitcoin. The company is now exploring expansion into crypto mining, lending, and potential share buybacks.

on_the_radar.title: Louisiana sues Kalshi, Robinhood and other prediction markets in escalating regulatory fight
on_the_radar.summary: Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill has filed a lawsuit against several major prediction markets and crypto exchanges, including Coinbase, Gemini, and Polymarket. The legal action marks an escalation in the regulatory fight over the legality of prediction markets within the state.

on_the_radar.title: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access
on_the_radar.summary: DTCC plans to expand its tokenized securities offerings to the Solana blockchain by 2027. However, the potential for increased trading activity may be hindered by existing regulatory restrictions regarding wallet access.

on_the_radar.title: BNY taps Figment to support staking on its digital asset custody platform
on_the_radar.summary: BNY is integrating Figment's staking services into its digital asset custody platform. This allows institutional clients, including asset managers and ETF issuers, to stake their digital assets held with the bank.

on_the_radar.title: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in largest contraction since 2022 bear market
on_the_radar.summary: The stablecoin market has experienced a $14.2 billion contraction, the largest since the 2022 bear market. This decline, led by USDT and USDC, suggests a decrease in available buying power for a potential crypto market rebound.

worth_a_read.title: Algorand Token Holder Report Q3 2026
worth_a_read.note: Messari's Q3 holder report for Algorand provides granular data on staking concentration and governance participation that informs whether the chain's recent technical upgrades are translating to holder behavior change.

worth_a_read.title: Aave’s Proposed V3 Core Cleanup Targets Riskier Collateral
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's analysis of Aave's V3 collateral cleanup proposal offers a template for how lending protocols should systematically de-risk their collateral pools before market stress tests them.

worth_a_read.title: Helium Token Holder Report Q3 2026
worth_a_read.note: The Helium token holder report tracks whether the migration to Solana and the mobile subscriber growth are actually improving token velocity and treasury sustainability.

worth_a_read.title: Power Perps: A Match Made in Heaven?
worth_a_read.note: Delphi's power perps research examines whether this derivatives structure solves the funding rate inefficiency in perpetual markets or merely relocates it.

worth_a_read.title: Building networks for agents
worth_a_read.note: a16z's framework for agent-native networks is worth reading for the specific architecture decisions that distinguish agent-to-agent transaction infrastructure from human-facing chains.

linkedin_post:
The NYSE did not choose Ethereum. Avalanche gets the 24/7 tokenized stock settlement contract, and that single procurement decision is worth more than a year of L1 marketing spend. We have been underwriting chain selection on the wrong variables—decentralization theater, validator count, community size—while institutional infrastructure operators underwrite on finality speed, subnet customization, and SLA enforceability. The repricing is underway.

This same week the Bank of England locked in 2028 for live tokenized FX settlement interfaces. Four years. That is a real timeline with real budget cycles, not a roadmap aspiration. It also means the window for competing chains to displace early selections is narrowing fast.

The Binance $6.3 billion breach runs parallel here: the CSO saw the fake interview vector months out. The failure was implementation, not imagination. Infrastructure security and infrastructure procurement are converging on one truth—execution velocity is the only variable that compounds.

What kills this thesis? If the NYSE pilot stalls on regulatory friction or if Avalanche's subnet economics cannot scale to equity-grade throughput. We will know within eighteen months.

For now, we are repricing L1 exposure toward chains that have won institutional RFPs, not those still pitching theoretical superiority.
